name: Animate my image
title: Animate my image — a clip from a still you already have
summary: Your own image brought to life as a short clip: nothing new is generated before it.
covers: a still the user already has (a photo, a shoot image, a generated still) turned into a short clip; the image itself is the first frame

shots.direction: The user's own image brought to life, as it is: the same person, outfit, place, light and framing. Only small, natural motion — the fabric or hair moving in a breeze, a breath, a slow turn of the head, a gentle camera push-in. Nothing added, removed or redrawn; the product's pattern and colours stay exact through the whole clip.
